months.note: 5월과 9~10월 이동기에 서해 섬 등에서 주로 보이고, 설악산 등 강원도 높은 산(해발 1,100m 이상)에서는 여름 내내 노래하는 개체가 있어 번식한다.

summary: 봄과 가을에 드물게 지나가는 나그네새이다. 여름에는 산지 침엽수림이나 강가 숲속에 살며 번식하고, 6~7월에 알을 5~6개 낳는다. 주로 곤충을 먹는다. 국내에서는 중부 이북에 살고, 국외에서는 시베리아, 몽골, 아무르, 우수리, 중국 등지에 분포한다.

art.subject: Two-barred Warbler (Phylloscopus plumbeitarsus), adult, as seen in Korean woods during passage in May and August-September: upperparts dark olive-green, the crown slightly darker and greyer, without a crown stripe; a long yellowish-white supercilium and a dark olive eye-stripe; ear coverts mottled pale yellow and dark brown; two whitish wing-bars - a broad, long one on the greater coverts and a shorter, thinner one on the median coverts; underparts whitish with a faint yellowish wash on the throat and breast and dusky olive neck sides and flanks; bill dark brown above with a pale yellowish-brown lower mandible; dark brown eye; dark lead-grey legs.
art.pose: gleaning insects among conifer twigs, side view
art.scene: Korean mountain conifer woods near a riverside thicket during spring or autumn passage; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view perched among conifer twigs: dark olive-green upperparts, greyish crown, long yellowish-white supercilium, two whitish wing-bars (the lower one broad), whitish underparts with a faint yellow wash on throat and breast, olive flanks, dark grey legs
adult, head detail in side view: ear coverts mottled pale yellow and dark brown, dark eye-stripe below a long pale supercilium, dark brown upper mandible and yellowish-brown lower mandible
art.build: Small leaf warbler, about 11cm, smaller than a sparrow, slim and active, with a rounded head and short tail. Bill fine and pointed, shorter than the head. Legs slender, dark lead-grey. The tail extends beyond the wingtips. Moves quickly through foliage, gleaning insects from twigs.
avoid: Do not paint pale pinkish or yellow legs; the legs are dark lead-grey.
Do not paint a single faint wing-bar; there are two, the lower one broad and obvious.
Do not paint a pale central crown stripe (Eastern Crowned Warbler) or a yellow rump (Pallas's Leaf Warbler).
Do not paint strongly yellow underparts.
